newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS to raise funds for Parkway.
newsitem.headline: DBS to raise funds for Parkway.

text.p: Property based DBS Land Ltd said on Tuesday it will make a placement of 91.9 million shares at Singapore $4.75 each.

The company said in a statement the placement would raise net proceeds of about S$427.7 million which "will be used to partially finance and refinance its purchase of shares of Parkway Holdings and to reduce bank borrowings".
DBS Land announced last week it had agreed to buy 19.2 perent of healthcare group Parkway for S$391 million.
When the placement is completed, the existing share capital of the company will increase to 1.01 billion shares of S$1 each from 919.20 million shares previously.
Group net tangible assets per share after adjusting for the placement will increase to S$4.48 from S$4.47.
The statement said DBS Bank, a substantial shareholder in DBS Land, and Morgan Stanley & Co International would jointly place the shares to investors.
The price of the placement shares is based on DBS Land's last transacted price of S$5 on June 2 less a five percent discount, it said.
